_comment: HUD region rects, authored as FRACTIONS of the 16:9 reference canvas (x,y,w,h in 0..1), mapped to the window's 16:9 safe area at render (see HudCanvas / docs/design/HUD.md). Screen-fixed overlay bands: CONTENT lower (ALL content boxes -- readings, thoughts, remarks, menus), NOTIFICATION right at the content-band top, UPPER (no content of its own; the teaching card parks there so it never covers the content it points at). Tune these by feel. visibility: 'auto' draws a region only when it holds content (calm default); 'on' shows always-on region frames; 'off' hides the HUD. Later flipped from the Settings menu.
